seed.source: Zapmap UK public charging networks guide, updated 2026-08-21 / entries updated 2026-09-08

cpos.name: Osprey Charging
cpos.evidence: Public Osprey portal API validates 407 locations and 2819 EVSE/connectors with live statuses. Official network pricing profiles joined in Data Lab: contactless £0.87/kWh, app standard £0.82, weekend saver £0.79, overnight saver £0.69.
cpos.next: validated; refresh public map plus official pricing profiles on schedule.

cpos.name: GRIDSERVE
cpos.evidence: First-party open-data page provides a form to request an API key for the public API under the Public Charge Point Regulations.
cpos.next: keep first-pass bounded; later test API after key or discover public endpoint.

cpos.name: MFG EV Power
cpos.evidence: Validated Data Lab collection: 595 locations, 3010 EVSEs/connectors, 10 tariffs; both referenced tariff IDs resolved; no missing tariff IDs.
cpos.next: validated; include in scheduled UK aggregation.

cpos.name: IONITY
cpos.evidence: Data Lab IONITY Direct UK validation: 82 UK operated locations, 860 connectors and 0 unpriced connectors. Connector prices recovered from IONITY DIRECT adhocPrice with GBP validation.
cpos.next: validated; refresh using established IONITY direct method.

cpos.name: InstaVolt
cpos.evidence: Operator public-regulation page instructs consumers to request open-data access by email, sign an Open Data Agreement, then receive credentials.
cpos.next: look for a directly callable open endpoint or machine-readable alternative before considering manual access request

cpos.name: Fastned
cpos.evidence: Data Lab direct UK validation: 41 UK locations and 259 charging points. Current direct pricing profiles are persisted: standard £0.79/kWh, app-direct £0.711/kWh, Gold £0.55/kWh with subscription metadata.
cpos.next: validated; refresh direct UK inventory and pricing profiles on schedule.

cpos.name: Be.EV
cpos.evidence: Be.EV public website map API validated in Data Lab: 600 Be.EV-operated sites, 1009 charge points, 2539 connectors. All 600 sites and all charge points expose tariffs; no missing tariff coverage.
cpos.next: validated; refresh public map API on schedule.

cpos.name: PoGo Charge
cpos.evidence: 158/159 upstream locations recovered; offset 158 returns HTTP 500 upstream. Pricing complete via official PoGo AC/DC tariffs and all local tariff links resolved.
cpos.next: keep bounded until upstream missing record recovers; pricing is complete.

cpos.name: Pod
cpos.evidence: Anonymous version discovery works; data modules return OCPI Unauthorized and require credentials exchange.
cpos.next: seek separate statutory public feed or onboarding route; do not block first pass

cpos.name: Applegreen Fast Charge
cpos.evidence: Applegreen Electric UK uses a Driivz-backed mobile app with real-time UK/IE station locations and availability. Public web/search surfaces confirm the live map/app but do not expose a directly callable open-data endpoint.
cpos.next: Recover Driivz/app endpoint via static app/backend inspection when available; no tariff extrapolation from sample sites.

cpos.name: bp pulse
cpos.evidence: UK CPO dataset index points to bp pulse regulation FAQ and an Eco-Movement API key route.
cpos.next: resolve first-party access instructions and Eco-Movement feed after first pass.

cpos.name: FOR EV
cpos.evidence: First-party regulation page states OCPI data is available on request.
cpos.next: seek callable endpoint or request route after first pass.

cpos.name: Wenea
cpos.evidence: Official Wenea Open Data ZIP discovered via the post-request download page. Data Lab recovered 210 UK locations, 628 EVSEs and 631 connectors. Upstream references one missing tariff id, so TCC applies Wenea's current official direct PAYG prices by connector power: £0.55/kWh AC <=22kW, £0.75/kWh DC 30-60kW, £0.85/kWh HPC 61-400kW. No connector lacks a power-band tariff.
cpos.next: validated; include ZIP refresh plus official tariff-page fallback in scheduled UK aggregation.

cpos.name: evyve
cpos.evidence: Evyve publishes a PCPR Open Data Request form and says data is provided within 48h; support is Eco-Movement.
cpos.next: second pass: test Eco-Movement PCPR route.

cpos.name: Source EV
cpos.evidence: Source EV compliance page provides PCPR data by request via Eco-Movement.
cpos.next: second pass: test Eco-Movement PCPR route.

cpos.name: Shell Recharge
cpos.evidence: Shell UK PCPR page routes open-data requests through Eco-Movement.
cpos.next: second pass: test Eco-Movement PCPR API.

cpos.name: Allego
cpos.evidence: First-pass search did not surface a direct UK PCPR feed.
cpos.next: second pass: inspect Allego OCPI/public data surfaces.

cpos.name: Arnold Clark Charge
cpos.evidence: Validated Fuuse open-data collection: 126 locations, 429 EVSEs/connectors, 2 tariffs, no missing tariff IDs.
cpos.next: validated; include in scheduled UK aggregation.

cpos.name: Smart Charge
cpos.evidence: Official Smart Charge FAQ states the PCPR open-access data endpoint details are provided by customer support on 0800 014 2141. Targeted public-web search did not surface the endpoint.
cpos.next: Do not reinvestigate until user provides Smart Charge support endpoint details.
cpos.setAsideReason: Awaiting user feedback from Smart Charge support.

cpos.name: Believ
cpos.evidence: Believ public portal exposes anonymous Next.js read-only server actions. Data Lab validated getLocations (706 count in live action response), getLocation and getChargingStationsByLocation with detailed connector status/power. No tariff/price fields are returned by these anonymous actions or public map payloads.
cpos.next: Inventory/status surface is bounded and usable. Pricing remains external-access only unless Believ later exposes it publicly; free Believ API account is the remaining step. Do not repeat public-route discovery.

cpos.name: Monta
cpos.evidence: Monta documents a UK OCPI 2.2.1 open-data locations endpoint with party_id filtering and pagination.
cpos.next: probe endpoint and identify UK party_ids/tariff linkage

cpos.name: Zest
cpos.evidence: Zest acknowledges PCPR/OCPI requirements publicly but first-pass search did not surface its own feed.
cpos.next: second pass: inspect Fuuse/white-label backend and operator site.

cpos.name: Roam
cpos.evidence: Official Roam charging-map page calls an anonymous Cloudflare Worker feed. Data Lab recovered 401 locations and 566 connectors with status. Feed contains no pricing fields; Roam states exact tariffs vary by site and should be checked in the app.
cpos.next: Inventory/status bounded complete; recover station-specific pricing layer from app/backend. Do not apply network-wide tariff extrapolation.

cpos.name: RAW Charging
cpos.evidence: RAW public frontend exposes OCPI client routes /ocpi/locations and /ocpi/tariffs/GB/CPIE plus a public-client function key, but direct probes against rawcharging.com and the visible Azure Function host with/without /api and key/header/query all return 404. No secret is persisted.
cpos.next: Keep bounded pending frontend/API host change or a newly exposed base URL; do not request user action yet.

cpos.name: Evolt
cpos.evidence: Validated Data Lab collection: 702 locations, 3389 EVSEs/connectors, 284 tariffs; 242 referenced tariff IDs all resolved.
cpos.next: validated; include in scheduled UK aggregation.

cpos.name: Lidl
cpos.evidence: Lidl GB operates its own charging locator and charging service; no public PCPR endpoint surfaced in first pass.
cpos.next: second pass: inspect Lidl Plus backend and identify legal CPO identity.

cpos.name: Forward EV
cpos.evidence: First-pass search did not surface a direct public PCPR feed.
cpos.next: second pass: identify backend/CPO identity.

cpos.name: Fuuse
cpos.evidence: Fuuse states CPOs can generate/copy their Open Data link for PCPR compliance; Fuuse also has a public developer API.
cpos.next: second pass: enumerate Fuuse-hosted UK CPO open-data links and determine whether Fuuse itself is a CPO in seed.

cpos.name: Connekt
cpos.evidence: First-pass search did not surface a direct public PCPR feed.
cpos.next: second pass: inspect app/backend/operator website.

cpos.name: Weev
cpos.evidence: Final keyless audit of Weev first-party public map/app bundles and source maps found no anonymous station/tariff API. The first-party frontend explicitly contains the open-data request component and POST route /api/open-data-api/send. Official Open Data access therefore requires the free API key request.
cpos.next: User/API requester must submit the Weev Open Data API-key form. Once key is received, ingest directly; do not repeat keyless discovery.

cpos.name: ParkRecharge
cpos.evidence: Official ParkRecharge public webapp exposes a read-only client key and Hubeleon devices endpoint. Data Lab collection recovered 459 geocoded devices and 839 connectors; device statuses are live and 429/459 devices expose explicit public pricing/fees. Zero-fee devices are preserved as published.
cpos.next: validated; refresh public webapp inventory/pricing on schedule.

cpos.name: ScottishPower Recharge
cpos.evidence: Validated Data Lab collection on 2026-09-28: 65 locations, 187 EVSE/connectors, 8 tariffs; all 8 referenced tariff IDs resolved.
cpos.next: validated; include in scheduled UK aggregation.

cpos.name: EZ-Charge
cpos.evidence: Official EZ-Charge driver page fetches a public Azure blob containing 28 site areas (id/name). Container listing is not enabled (404); blob has no coordinates, status or pricing fields. General pricing is public but site-specific pricing is explicitly map-dependent.
cpos.next: Inventory seed retained; recover detailed map/app backend later. Do not extrapolate general tariff over site-specific exceptions.

cpos.name: GeniePoint
cpos.evidence: UK CPO dataset index points to a GeniePoint open-data page.
cpos.next: probe locations/tariffs feed.

cpos.name: Mer
cpos.evidence: Validated Data Lab collection on 2026-09-28: 182 locations, 823 EVSE/connectors, 66 tariff rows; all 64 referenced tariff IDs resolved.
cpos.next: validated; include in scheduled UK aggregation.

cpos.name: Clenergy EV
cpos.evidence: Validated Data Lab collection: 1400 locations, 1714 EVSEs/connectors, 130 tariffs; 130/130 referenced tariff IDs resolved.
cpos.next: validated; include in scheduled UK aggregation.

cpos.name: Qwello
cpos.evidence: Qwello public tariff frontend resolves to a public JSON feed. Data Lab recovered 96 UK stations, 305 GB EVSE IDs and tariff objects for all 96 stations in GBP. Rows contain EVSE IDs, location/city and tariffs but no latitude/longitude.
cpos.next: Pricing layer complete. Join the 305 GB EVSE IDs to a geolocated inventory/app feed; do not rediscover tariff source.

cpos.name: ChargePoint
cpos.evidence: ChargePoint UK says public CMS station data is available via API request through an external partner.
cpos.next: second pass: resolve partner form/API and UK CMS data.

cpos.name: char.gy
cpos.evidence: Sharded official feed collection recovered full advertised inventory: 5862/5862 locations, 5864 EVSE/connectors. Current tariffs endpoint exposes 3 tariffs while connectors reference 7 IDs; 5 referenced IDs return 404 individually and are absent from the current tariff list.
cpos.next: Inventory coverage complete. Keep pricing partial until 5 historical/secondary tariff references are reconciled; do not rerun full inventory unless upstream changes.

cpos.name: TotalEnergies
cpos.evidence: Official UK Charging Services site and tariffs are browser-accessible, but GitHub runner access to the find-a-charger page returns HTTP 403, preventing static bundle/API discovery there. Keep public UK pricing separately; inventory backend still unresolved.
cpos.next: Revisit with browser/network inspection when available; no user action required now.

cpos.name: Connected Kerb
cpos.evidence: Connected Kerb operates OCPI at https://cp.connectedkerb.com/ocpi/ and an AMPECO public API at /public-api/. Both return 401 anonymously; bearer tokens are issued from the operator back office and there is no public self-service credential path.
cpos.next: External API/OCPI credential required; keep set aside until credentials/onboarding become available.

cpos.name: Charge My Street
cpos.evidence: First-pass search did not surface a direct PCPR feed.
cpos.next: second pass: inspect operator/backend and local authority feeds.

cpos.name: Shell Recharge ubitricity
cpos.evidence: UK CPO dataset index points to Shell open-data request and Eco-Movement PCPR API.
cpos.next: test Eco-Movement public-regulation feed path.

cpos.name: Blink
cpos.evidence: UK CPO dataset index points to Blink UK Open Data Request.
cpos.next: resolve endpoint/access mechanics after first pass.

cpos.name: JOLT
cpos.evidence: Official JOLT UK PCPR page publishes a public locations API and tariff-by-id API. Data Lab collection on 2026-09-28 recovered 71 locations, 157 EVSEs, 155 connectors and all 5 referenced tariffs with no tariff failures.
cpos.next: validated; include in TCC UK aggregation and scheduled refresh.

cpos.name: 3ti Energy Hubs
cpos.evidence: 3ti public charge-points page embeds six Fuuse Open Data site UUIDs. Throttled Data Lab collection resolved all six without failures: 7 locations, 78 EVSE/connectors, 6 tariffs and no missing tariff IDs.
cpos.next: validated; refresh six Fuuse site feeds with conservative rate limiting.

registryReconciliation.role: national GB/IE e-mobility ID register; used as CPO identity control universe, not as proof that every registrant operates public chargepoints
registryReconciliation.next: classify every GB operator ID as public-network / private-or-fleet / backend-platform / duplicate-alias / uncertain, and first-pass every public-network candidate
registryReconciliation.method: Conservative identity classification: confirmed/strong public-network candidates are retained for TCC first-pass; obvious CPMS/eMSP/fleet roles are excluded from public-network coverage count; site-owner/brand cases remain to be checked.

The previous 44/44 completion remains only the Zapmap major-network seed pass; country-level first pass is reopened until EV Roam candidates are classified and all public-network candidates receive a first-pass investigation.

EV Roam identity classification completed conservatively. 'Classification complete' means every registry ID has a role/status label, not that every uncertain identity has been fully resolved. Only confirmed/strong public networks should enter the TCC public-CPO coverage denominator.

Remaining work is second-pass resolution of partials and extraction/normalisation of source-identified networks; non-core/fleet/backend/legacy identities stay outside the public-CPO denominator unless new evidence emerges.

All raw OCPI tariff components, VAT, restrictions and min_price values are preserved. CPS tariff coverage is therefore complete after cross-feed reconciliation. Finalized 2026-09-28: all 10 dangling tariff ids were resolved by matching each id's exact location group to the current/latest authoritative tariff published by the relevant charge point owner or ChargePlace Scotland.
